title: Traveling musicians, transfers and dues in the locals
summary: Goodwin and Smith compare transfer rules, ten percent travelling dues and the cost of joining Local 34627.

story.theme_name: The musicians' union: cards, locals, and the Black-white merger
story.community_name: The musicians' union: cards, scale and the black-white merger

blocks.x: Six months.
Well that's a transfer.
Yeah, you could transfer in at six months see but you could join there as a traveling musician and pay their dues but I don't think the set up then was as it is now.
Well in the old days we paid ten percent, ten percent of the action with the local.
Yeah but you get that back though, you get that ten percent back.
Well today it isn't that way. You don't pay the ten percent anymore.
Well, you pay ten percent traveling, yeah.
Into the local you go into?
Yeah.
Well --
Ten percent traveling, yeah. This goes to the --
The hospitalization and [all that,] yeah.
Yeah, but we got --

But you don't really have any -- well supposing came -- well every -- we've had bands come in here. I can't remember any -- well Rockwell, Rocky Rockwell came in for a long period of weeks but not a big band for a long time.
Do we have that in Local 34627? You're an officer of the local.
Yeah.
In other words --
You can do it more now then you could then.
Kick a band out after two weeks, a big band?
No.
You don't here?
Well, a big band we possibly would.
Yeah.
You could be booked now, say, for six weeks or however --
Anywhere?
Yeah.
In Chicago too?
But they've got a different thing going, see. You have to join this local while you're here. You have to pay dues.
Pro rata -- well the dues --
Yeah, four and a quarter.
Well I wouldn't mind paying that.
Well, you see, this --
The initiation would be a problem.
Well, if you want to join now you --
Well you couldn't join -- you know, initiate every local. I wouldn't mind paying --
But you still have to establish residence here.
Yeah, I wouldn't want to pay the initiation of every local I went into.
You had to -- our local here, 34627, is $156.00. It's just the same as joining from scratch --
I realize that.
-- but the only thing you don't pay is the part you pay to the national.
